1100.name: The Lair of a Scaled Beast

north.description: To the north lies A Waterlogged Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies Deeper Under the Ocean.

1100.description:
The lair is a broad, low chamber where the floor has been trodden into a
hollow of black mud and scattered gnawed bones. Greasy scales, shed in
long grey sheets, litter the slope toward a heap of torn weed and rotten
matting in the middle. The air is thick and warm and tastes of spoiled
fish. A heavy door in the north wall leads back to a waterlogged
corridor, while a rough opening to the east runs toward a damper passage
under the ocean.

1101.name: A Waterlogged Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Waterlogged Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Lair of a Scaled Beast.

1101.description:
Ankle-deep water fills this corridor from wall to wall, black and
perfectly still until a drip from the ceiling sets rings spreading
across it. The blocks of the walls are furred with green slime to the
height of your chest. Behind you to the south hangs the heavy door of
the lair, and the corridor goes on north through the murk. Every
footstep slaps and echoes along the stone.

1102.name: A Waterlogged Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Waterlogged Bend.

south.description: To the south lies A Waterlogged Corridor.

1102.description:
The water runs deeper here, lapping against your shins, and a cold
current tugs along the floor. Pale mineral crusts hang from the vaulted
roof like frozen candle-wax, dripping steadily. Cracked carvings of
coiling lizards march along the wall at eye level, their scales worn
smooth by wet and time. The corridor continues north toward a bend, and
back south toward the lair.

1103.name: A Waterlogged Bend

east.description: To the east lies Slippery Ledge.

south.description: To the south lies A Waterlogged Corridor.

1103.description:
The corridor bends sharply here, the flooded floor giving way on the
east side to a raised shelf of stone above the water. A rusted iron ring
hangs from the wall, green with age, where some long-dead keeper once
moored a boat. Echoes of dripping seem to arrive from every side at
once. You can follow the shelf east onto a ledge or wade back south down
the corridor.

1104.name: Slippery Ledge

north.description: To the north lies Shrine to a Lizardine Warrior.

east.description: To the east lies Further Along the Ledge.

west.description: To the west lies A Waterlogged Bend.

1104.description:
A narrow ledge of wet stone runs along the edge of a black drop, glossy
with slime and treacherous underfoot. Below the lip the water of the
temple's drowned lower halls shivers in the dark. To the north an
archway glimmers with the faint yellow light of candles, while the ledge
goes on east and returns west to the bend. Cling to the wall and take
small steps.

1105.name: Shrine to a Lizardine Warrior

south.description: To the south lies Slippery Ledge.

1105.description:
A small shrine fills this alcove, built around the stone figure of a
lizardine warrior standing with a notched blade held across its chest.
Stubs of black candles gutter on the shelf at its feet beside dishes of
dried blood and fish scales. The carved eyes catch the flame and seem to
follow you across the damp floor. The only way out is the archway south
onto the ledge.

extra_descs.statue figure warrior:
The lizardine warrior is carved from green-black stone, one clawed foot
forward and its jaws half open in a battle cry. Its blade is notched in
seven places, each notch filled with a pinch of red wax.

1106.name: Further Along the Ledge

east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Tunnel Entrance.

west.description: To the west lies Slippery Ledge.

1106.description:
The ledge narrows to little more than a foot's width, and spray from
somewhere below leaves the stone as slick as soap. A thin stream
trickles down the wall to join the dark water beneath. Ahead the passage
opens east into a tunnel mouth, while the way west leads back toward the
shrine. A fall here would mean a cold, black drenching.

1107.name: A Narrow Tunnel Entrance

north.description: To the north lies A Narrow Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Further Along the Ledge.

1107.description:
The ledge ends where the wall is broken by a ragged hole, the beginning
of a tunnel hacked roughly through the living rock. Scratch marks of
claws and crude chisels cover the jambs. Cold air breathes out of the
dark, smelling of moss and standing water. The tunnel climbs on north,
and the ledge lies back west.

1108.name: A Narrow Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Narrow Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Narrow Tunnel Entrance.

1108.description:
The tunnel squeezes so tight that your shoulders brush the rock on
either side, wet and cold as a cellar. Water seeps from every crack and
gathers in a rill running along the floor. The roof is low enough to
make you stoop at every step. It winds on north into blackness and south
toward the entrance.

1109.name: A Narrow Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Rock Platform.

south.description: To the south lies A Narrow Tunnel.

1109.description:
Here the tunnel widens a little and the floor is scored with long drag
marks, as if heavy sacks had been hauled through. Pale threads of fungus
glow dimly in the cracks of the rock. A brackish smell drifts down from
the north, where the passage opens out. Back south the squeeze continues
toward the ledge.

1110.name: A Damp Rock Platform

south.description: To the south lies A Narrow Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies An Underground Pool.

1110.description:
A flat shelf of rock juts out over an underground pool, its surface
beaded with damp and stained with old green streaks. The pool is wide,
still and black, and the roof above is lost in darkness. West the
platform drops to the water's edge, where a rotting mooring post leans
out over the water. South the tunnel climbs away into the rock.

1111.name: An Underground Pool

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Rock Platform.

south.description: To the south lies An Underground Pool.

west.description: To the west lies An Underground Pool.

1111.description:
You drift on the black water of an underground pool, the surface smooth
as glass except for the rings left by your own passage. Overhead the
roof is hung with pale stone teeth that drip steadily into the dark. A
rock platform lies east, and open water stretches west and south. The
air is cold and smells of old stone and weed.

1112.name: An Underground Pool

north.description: To the north lies Massive Stone Gates.

east.description: To the east lies An Underground Pool.

south.description: To the south lies An Underground Pool.

1112.description:
A great flight of weathered steps rises out of the pool to a pair of
massive gates. No torch burns here, but pale fungus on the stonework
gives a greenish gleam by which carved scales and claws can be made out.
The swell of your passage slaps loudly against the lowest step. East and
south the water darkens into the cavern, while the gates stand to the
north.

1113.name: Massive Stone Gates

north.description: To the north lies A Dripping Intersection.

south.description: To the south lies An Underground Pool.

1113.description:
Two colossal stone gates, carved with writhing lizard-gods and dripping
with condensation, tower over a landing at the water's edge. Their
surfaces are scarred where claws have scraped for centuries. A smaller
door set into the north gate stands ajar, letting out a draught of damp
air from the temple within. South the pool glimmers dark and cold
beneath the steps.

1114.name: A Rough Slope

north.description: To the north lies A Moist Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies A Dead End.

1114.description:
A rough slope of loose rock and gravel drops away steeply into the
earth, treacherous when wet. Rusted pitons have been hammered into the
wall to serve as handholds. The air below smells older, drier and
stranger. The tunnel lies north above you, and the slope goes down into
the dark.

1115.name: A Moist Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Dripping Intersection.

west.description: To the west lies A Moist Tunnel.

1115.description:
Moisture beads the low roof of this tunnel and falls in a steady patter
that never stops. The floor is rough rock with a trough worn down the
middle by many feet. The tunnel goes on west into the dark, and east it
opens onto a dripping intersection.

1116.name: Gates to the Temple

north.description: To the north lies Temple of Zaebos.

east.description: To the east lies A Submerged Passageway.

west.description: To the west lies A Guard Room.

1116.description:
A pair of tall bronze doors, green with verdigris and pushed open on
corroded hinges, mark the entrance to the temple proper. Braziers of
black iron burn with a sullen red glow on either side, throwing long
shadows over the wet floor. North opens the great hall of Zaebos, and a
low archway to the west leads into a guard room. East the passage runs
back toward the flooded halls.

extra_descs.bronze doors verdigris:
The doors are twice the height of a man, cast with scaled figures that
kneel before a crowned serpent. Time has turned the bronze a mottled
green.

1117.name: Temple of Zaebos

north.description: To the north lies Temple of Zaebos.

east.description: To the east lies Temple of Zaebos.

west.description: To the west lies A Temple Corridor.

1117.description:
The western end of the temple narrows where a wide archway leads out
into a corridor. Clusters of cold candle stubs fill the sconces, and the
stones beneath your feet are slick with wax and wet. A rack of rusted
spears leans in the corner, long forgotten. The floor runs north into a
shrine corner and east into the nave.

1118.name: Altar of God King

north.description: To the north lies A Spiral Staircase.

east.description: To the east lies Temple of Zaebos.

south.description: To the south lies Temple of Zaebos.

west.description: To the west lies Temple of Zaebos.

1118.description:
A massive altar of black stone dominates this end of the hall, its top
channelled and stained dark with old sacrifice. Above it a gilded relief
shows the God King of the lizardfolk crowned and coiled, his jewelled
eyes glinting. A door of dull bronze stands in the north wall behind the
altar, and the aisles of the temple lead east and west. South the nave
opens out.

extra_descs.relief god king:
The gilded relief shows a crowned, coiling lizard with garnet eyes, the
God King Zaebos is said to serve. Its claws are raised over a heap of
small, carved skulls.

1119.name: Temple of Zaebos

north.description: To the north lies Temple of Zaebos.

west.description: To the west lies Temple of Zaebos.

1119.description:
The side aisle of the temple lies in deep shadow between rows of stout
pillars, each wound with a carved serpent. Offerings of dried fish and
tarnished coins are heaped in the gaps between them. The floor slopes
slightly, and water gathers in the lowest flags. The aisle leads north
toward a chapel and west back into the great nave.

1120.name: Temple of Zaebos

north.description: To the north lies Altar of God King.

east.description: To the east lies Temple of Zaebos.

south.description: To the south lies Gates to the Temple.

west.description: To the west lies Temple of Zaebos.

1120.description:
The nave of the temple stretches away in the gloom, its high pillars
carved in spirals of scales and rising into smoky dimness. The
flagstones are polished by generations of bare, clawed feet, and rows of
low stone benches face the front. To the north, steps climb toward an
altar. Aisles run east and west among the columns, and the gates lie
south.

1121.name: Temple of Zaebos

east.description: To the east lies Altar of God King.

south.description: To the south lies Temple of Zaebos.

1121.description:
A tall niche in the wall holds a faded mosaic of a lizard host marching
into a sunrise, its tiles cracked and missing. Cobwebs hang in the
corners above a row of cold, empty braziers. The altar stands east, lit
by its own dull gleam, and the nave runs south. A sour smell of old
incense clings to the stones.

1122.name: Temple of Zaebos

south.description: To the south lies Temple of Zaebos.

west.description: To the west lies Altar of God King.

1122.description:
This corner of the temple is a side chapel hung with ragged banners of
green and gold, stirring in a draught from nowhere. Benches of stone
line the walls, and a shallow font of stagnant water stands beside a
pillar. Green mould creeps up the hangings from the floor. The nave
continues south and the altar lies west.

1123.name: A Spiral Staircase

south.description: To the south lies Altar of God King.

down.description: To the down lies A Golden Spiral Staircase.

1123.description:
A narrow stair of black stone begins here, winding down into the rock
around a thick central pillar. The steps are worn into shallow dishes by
long use and slick with seeping water. The bronze door you came through
lies south, back in the altar hall. The air grows warmer and fainter
with each turn downward.

1124.name: A Golden Spiral Staircase

up.description: To the up lies A Spiral Staircase.

down.description: To the down lies The Base of the Staircase.

1124.description:
The staircase here is inlaid with gold, its rail and risers sparkling
dully where the damp has not dulled the metal. Tiny gilded scales run
along the banister, each polished by countless palms. Light glows from
somewhere far below and wavers on the curving wall. The stair climbs up
toward the altar door and winds down toward the glow.

1125.name: The Base of the Staircase

north.description: To the north lies A Magnificent Corridor.

up.description: To the up lies A Golden Spiral Staircase.

1125.description:
The spiral ends in a round chamber floored with pale marble veined with
gold. A tall mirror of polished bronze stands against the wall, throwing
the glow of the corridor back at you. The staircase rises behind you
into the dark, and a magnificent corridor opens north. The air is warm
and dry and smells faintly of cedar and old parchment.

extra_descs.mirror bronze:
The bronze has been polished so long it gives back a warm, wavering
image. A crack runs across one corner.

1126.name: A Magnificent Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Magnificent Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Base of the Staircase.

1126.description:
Tall pillars of white stone march down this corridor, their capitals
gilded and carved as scaly lilies. A long runner of faded crimson silk
covers the floor, frayed at the edges. Oil lamps hang from silver chains
and shed a soft glow on frescoes of lizard kings at war. The corridor
goes on north, and the staircase chamber lies south.

1127.name: A Magnificent Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Magnificent Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Magnificent Corridor.

1127.description:
The corridor turns here, and the frescoes on the walls change from war
to feasting: great tables laden with fruit, fish and wine for scaled
lords. Many of the painted faces have been scored away by claws. Fine
gold dust lies in the gutters of the mouldings. Southward the way runs
back to the staircase, and it bends on east.

1128.name: A Magnificent Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Magnificent Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies A Magnificent Corridor.

1128.description:
A glass-fronted case, long since emptied and cracked, stands in an
alcove at this corner of the corridor. The marble floor is clean here,
as if lately swept, and the lamps have been trimmed. A faint scent of
old incense hangs in the still air. The corridor runs north toward a
junction of doors and back west around the turn.

1129.name: A Magnificent Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Walkway of Light.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Library.

south.description: To the south lies A Magnificent Corridor.

1129.description:
At this junction the corridor ends in a handsome door of pale wood
inlaid with a sunburst, and an open archway to the east shows shelves of
books. The pillars here are ringed with bands of gold leaf. Lamplight
shimmers on the polished floor. The way south returns along the
corridor, while the north door promises a brighter room.

1130.name: A Small Library

west.description: To the west lies A Magnificent Corridor.

1130.description:
Shelves of dark wood reach to the ceiling, crowded with scrolls, clay
tablets and rotting books in a script of hooks and curls. A reading desk
stands under a hanging lamp, its surface scratched with claw marks. The
pages smell of damp and old glue, and many have swollen and stuck
together. The archway west leads back to the corridor.

1131.name: Walkway of Light

north.description: To the north lies A Shining Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies A Magnificent Corridor.

1131.description:
The walkway glows with a soft radiance that seems to come from the very
stones, pale as moonlight on water. Mirrors of polished silver set at
angles along its sides fling the glow back and forth until there are no
shadows. The floor is a strip of white crystal worn smooth. It runs
north to a shining chamber, and the door lies behind you to the south.

1132.name: A Shining Chamber

south.description: To the south lies Walkway of Light.

1132.description:
Every wall of this small round chamber is sheathed in beaten silver and
polished until it dazzles, so that you see yourself a hundred times
over. In the middle stands an empty pedestal of crystal, its top
hollowed as if for a bowl or a crown. The light is nearly painful and
the air still and warm. The only way out is the walkway south.

extra_descs.pedestal crystal:
The crystal pedestal is hollowed on top and stained green at the bottom
of the hollow. Whatever once rested there has been taken.

1133.name: A Submerged Passageway

east.description: To the east lies A Submerged Passageway.

west.description: To the west lies Gates to the Temple.

1133.description:
Dry enough to stand easily, this stretch of passage is lined with
pillars carved into rearing serpents, their fangs bared. The floor still
glistens, and in places shallow pools reflect a trembling light from the
west. You hear a low chanting there, thin and sibilant. East the passage
dives back toward the water.

1134.name: A Submerged Passageway

east.description: To the east lies A Submerged Bend.

west.description: To the west lies A Submerged Passageway.

1134.description:
Here the floor rises from the flood to a drowned walkway of cracked
flagstones, wet and green. The water laps at the edge of the stone to
the east, where the passage drops into a bend. A line of niches in the
wall holds only sodden ash and a few clay shards. West the way continues
toward a faint flicker of light.

1135.name: A Submerged Bend

south.description: To the south lies A Submerged Bend.

west.description: To the west lies A Submerged Passageway.

1135.description:
Your raft slides around a second bend where the passage swings west
again toward drier stone. A rotted portcullis, its bars thick with weed,
hangs half raised from the ceiling. Bubbles seep up from a crack in the
flooded floor and pop against the hull. South the water deepens, and a
faint draught from the west carries a smell of incense.

1136.name: A Submerged Bend

north.description: To the north lies A Submerged Bend.

west.description: To the west lies A Submerged Passageway.

1136.description:
The flooded passage turns north here, deep enough that you must float
rather than wade. The water is cold and tea-dark, and the stone walls on
either side drop sheer into it. Faint scratches near the waterline mark
where the level has risen and fallen over the years. The way back west
leads to a shallower passage, and the bend continues north.

1137.name: A Submerged Passageway

east.description: To the east lies A Submerged Bend.

west.description: To the west lies A Dripping Intersection.

1137.description:
The passageway lies half under water, the floor sloping gently so that
the flood deepens with each step east. Rotting wooden brackets in the
walls once held torches and now hold only knots of pale fungus. Ripples
spread from your wake and bump against the far wall. West stands the
intersection, dry by comparison.

1138.name: A Dripping Intersection

east.description: To the east lies A Submerged Passageway.

south.description: To the south lies Massive Stone Gates.

west.description: To the west lies A Moist Tunnel.

1138.description:
Water drips from the vault in a hundred places, plinking into puddles
that cover the floor of this crossing. Passages lead east and west, and
a door stands open in the south wall onto the great gates. A worn mosaic
of coiling serpents decorates the floor under the grime. The echo of
each drop wanders off down the corridors.

1139.name: A Moist Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Moist Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Rough Slope.

1139.description:
The tunnel bends here around a rounded knob of stone, rubbed smooth by
passing shoulders. A pale slime coats the lower walls, and the floor is
crusted with white mineral growths. Cold air flows up from a slope to
the south. East the passage returns toward a crossing of corridors.

1140.name: A Damp Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Temple Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Damp Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies Sleeping Chambers.

1140.description:
The cavern is a lumpy hollow in the rock, its roof hung with dripping
spikes and its floor a mat of mud and trampled reeds. Strings of beads
and bone charms are tied across an opening in the west wall, marking the
sleeping chambers. Water trickles down the walls and collects in cracks,
and the air is thick and warm. North a passage leads toward the temple,
and the cavern continues south.

1141.name: A Damp Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Crack in the Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies Sleeping Chambers.

1141.description:
Broken ground slopes through this part of the cavern, pocked with
puddles that mirror the pale glimmer of fungus overhead. A heap of
sleeping mats and rushes lies against the west wall by a low opening.
The rock walls are sticky with moisture and ring with distant dripping.
A crevice at the southern end leads on, and the cavern runs north.

1142.name: A Temple Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Temple Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Damp Cavern.

1142.description:
The stonework of the corridor gives way by degrees to bare rock, and the
walls begin to look gnawed rather than cut. Ropes of pale fungus hang
from the roof and brush your face. The floor tilts downward ahead into a
damp hollow, and the dressed stone of the temple passage lies north
behind you. A steady drip counts out the seconds.

1146.name: An Underground Pool

north.description: To the north lies An Underground Pool.

west.description: To the west lies An Underground Pool.

1146.description:
The pool narrows here against a wall of dark rock that rises sheer from
the water, slick with moisture. Your raft turns slowly in a faint eddy
as if something beneath had stirred. Small bubbles rise now and then and
burst with a soft sound. The water opens north back toward the middle of
the pool and west across a darker stretch.

1147.name: An Underground Pool

north.description: To the north lies An Underground Pool.

east.description: To the east lies An Underground Pool.

west.description: To the west lies Lair of the Vraal.

1147.description:
A low arch of rock stands at the pool's edge, and beyond it to the west
a ledge of mud and worked stone leads into a lair. The water here is
thick with floating weed that trails against your raft. A rank, warm
smell drifts out of the arch, laced with something like rotten eggs.
Open water lies north and east.

1148.name: Lair of the Vraal

east.description: To the east lies An Underground Pool.

up.description: To the up lies A Warm Damp Room.

1148.description:
A wide, hot cavern, its floor strewn with glistening nests of mud and
reeds, serves as the home of the Vraal. Cracked eggshells and scraps of
hide lie everywhere, and the smell of musk and brine is overpowering. A
stair of crude stone steps leads up to a warmer chamber. The pool lies
east beyond a ledge of mud.

1149.name: A Guard Room

east.description: To the east lies Gates to the Temple.

1149.description:
A bare square room off the gates, where the guards of the temple are
quartered. A rough table of stone stands in the middle, scored with
game-lines and knife cuts, and racks along the walls hold nothing but
rust. A hearth in the corner is choked with cold ash. The only way out
is the archway east to the gates.

1150.name: A Warm Damp Room

down.description: To the down lies Lair of the Vraal.

1150.description:
Steam curls from cracks in the rock, filling this small chamber with a
heavy, tropical warmth. The walls drip with condensation and the floor
is smeared with soft yellow clay. A thick mat of moss covers the corner,
still holding the shape of a large body. The only way out is the steps
down into the lair.

1151.name: A Temple Corridor

east.description: To the east lies Temple of Zaebos.

west.description: To the west lies A Temple Corridor.

1151.description:
Stone blocks sweat in this plain corridor, which has none of the
grandeur of the hall behind. Water seeps from the joints of the masonry
and collects in a channel along the floor. A line of torches has burned
down to blackened stumps in iron brackets. To the east the temple opens
out, and to the west the passage goes on.

1152.name: A Temple Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Temple Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Temple Corridor.

1152.description:
The corridor corners here with a sharp turn, and the damp is thick
enough to bead on your sleeves. A smear of green algae climbs the stones
from floor to knee. Someone has scratched a tally of days into the wall
in neat rows. East the corridor returns toward the temple, while a
draughty passage leads south.

extra_descs.tally scratches rows:
Hundreds of tiny strokes, grouped in fives, march across the stone in
tidy rows. The last row stops abruptly, mid-count.

1153.name: Sleeping Chambers

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Cavern.

1153.description:
A low chamber lined with beds of dried reeds and old sacking, each
arranged in a neat row along the wall. Blankets of coarse, scaled hide
are folded at the head of every bed. The air is warm and stale and
smells of musk. Round shields hang on pegs beside a rough opening that
leads east back to the damp cavern.

1154.name: Sleeping Chambers

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Cavern.

1154.description:
Rows of narrow stone slabs serve as beds in this chamber, each padded
with a litter of dried weed gone brown and brittle. Small clay lamps,
burnt dry, sit in niches above the pillows. Claw marks cover the rock
where sleepers have scratched the days away. The only way out is the
opening east into the damp cavern.

1155.name: A Dead End

west.description: To the west lies A Hidden Room.

up.description: To the up lies A Rough Slope.

1155.description:
The slope ends in a blank wall of dressed stone, which seems a dead end
until you notice the thin line of a narrow door in the west face. Grit
crunches underfoot, and the dust lies thick on everything but the
threshold. A faint draught slides under the door. The slope climbs back
up behind you.

1156.name: A Hidden Room

east.description: To the east lies A Dead End.

west.description: To the west lies A Rough Corridor.

1156.description:
A small hidden room with no windows, its walls plastered and faded with
the ghost of old paintings. A cracked table and an overturned stool are
the only furniture, and a heap of rotted cloth lies in a corner. The
door to the east stands open on the dead end, while a rough passage
leads west. Dust hangs motionless in the air.

1157.name: A Rough Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Hidden Room.

west.description: To the west lies A Rough Corridor.

1157.description:
The corridor here is bare rock, chiselled square and left unfinished,
with tool marks still plain on the walls. A pair of iron brackets hold
the black stubs of torches. The floor is dry, a relief after the wet
halls above. It runs east toward the hidden room and west into further
corridor.

1158.name: A Rough Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Prison of The Greedy.

east.description: To the east lies A Rough Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies A Rough Corridor.

1158.description:
Iron-bound doors face one another in the walls of this corridor, their
small grilles dark. The air here is cold and carries a sour tang of rust
and old straw. Chains dangle from rings in the roof. A heavy door in the
north wall leads to a cell, and the corridor runs east and west.

1159.name: A Rough Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Rough Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies Secret Treasury.

west.description: To the west lies A Rough Corridor.

1159.description:
The corridor widens into a crossing here, with a heavy door set into the
wall to the south. Dust lies deep, but a trail of clawed prints runs to
the door and back. The ceiling is low and the air is dry and slightly
sweet, like old coins. Passages run east and west into the dim.

1160.name: A Rough Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Prison of the Greedy.

east.description: To the east lies A Rough Corridor.

1160.description:
The corridor ends here against a heavy door in the north wall, studded
with iron bolts as thick as thumbs. A candle stub in a niche has long
since drowned in its own wax. The floor is grooved where the door has
been dragged open many times. The passage runs back east toward a
crossing.

1161.name: Prison of the Greedy

south.description: To the south lies A Rough Corridor.

1161.description:
A stone cell fitted with a rusted cage of iron bars bolted to the floor,
just large enough for one crouching prisoner. A plate bearing a lizard
glyph hangs from a chain, scorched with old fingermarks. The stone is
slick with cold sweat, and the silence presses in. Rusted manacles lie
in a heap beside the bars.

1162.name: Secret Treasury

north.description: To the north lies A Rough Corridor.

1162.description:
Chests of rotten oak lie smashed open along the walls of this
strongroom, and a scatter of tarnished coins glints in the dust. An
iron-banded vault door hangs from a single hinge. The ceiling is stained
black by smoke, as if the place had been burned out long ago. The only
exit is the door north into the corridor.

extra_descs.chests coins:
The chests were split open by axes, and the coins that remain are too
worn and corroded to spend. Whoever came before took everything of
weight.

1163.name: Prison of The Greedy

south.description: To the south lies A Rough Corridor.

1163.description:
A bare prison cell of rough stone, scarcely wide enough to lie down in.
Iron rings are set in the wall at ankle height, and the floor is worn
into a shallow dip where unnumbered prisoners have sat. Scratched words,
too faint to read, cover the stone. Nothing moves in the heavy silence.

1165.name: Deeper Under the Ocean

east.description: To the east lies A Cave Beneath the Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies The Lair of a Scaled Beast.

1165.description:
The passage descends into a drowned gallery where the roar of the ocean
is heard faintly through the rock overhead. Sheets of salt have dried on
the walls like frost. Pools of seawater lie in hollows of the floor,
shivering whenever the sea booms. The way west leads back to the lair,
and the passage goes on east.

1166.name: A Cave Beneath the Ocean

east.description: To the east lies A Cave-Mouth Leading Into the Sand.

west.description: To the west lies Deeper Under the Ocean.

1166.description:
A cave beneath the sea opens wide here, its walls thick with barnacles
and the empty tubes of worms. Weed hangs in dark ropes from the roof,
dripping brine. The deep thud of waves comes through the rock like a
slow heartbeat. Sandy ground rises to the east, and the way west returns
to the gallery.

1167.name: A Cave-Mouth Leading Into the Sand

west.description: To the west lies A Cave Beneath the Ocean.

up.description: To the up lies At an Ocean Cave.

1167.description:
The cave narrows to a mouth half choked with drifted sand, where the
floor climbs toward grey light. Shells and wrack litter the sand, and
the air smells of salt and sun. A steep passage rises above you toward a
sea cave and the open world. The way west leads back into the dark
beneath the ocean.

1168.name: A Crack in the Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Cavern.

1168.description:
The cavern shrinks to a crack barely wide enough to squeeze into, ending
in a pocket of dry rock. Faint scrawls of claws mark the stone, and a
few small bones lie in the dust. The air does not move, and the sound of
dripping is muffled. The only way out is back north into the cavern.

645200.name: lizardman guard lizardfolk scaled
645200.long_desc: A scaled lizardman guard stands on watch here, a barbed spear in its claws.
645200.description:
Broad shoulders and a ridged tail mark this guard as a temple warrior of
Zaebos. Its green hide is crossed with old scars and its yellow eyes
never blink. It hisses as you meet its gaze.

645201.name: cultist lizardfolk priest acolyte
645201.long_desc: A lizardfolk cultist in a tattered green robe mutters prayers to the God King.
645201.description:
This smaller lizardfolk wears a robe stitched with scales of gilded tin.
Its tongue flicks in and out between muttered words. A string of clay
beads hangs at its neck.

645202.name: snake water serpent pool
645202.long_desc: A pale water snake glides across the surface of the pool, its eyes like black pins.
645202.description:
The snake is as thick as your arm and nearly as long as a boat oar. Its
belly is the colour of old bone. It coils and sways, watching you.

645203.name: crocodile cave reptile
645203.long_desc: A blind cave crocodile lies half in the shallows, jaws parted and listening.
645203.description:
Long years in the dark have bleached this crocodile white and left its
eyes as milky pearls. Its snout tilts toward every sound. The jaws are
lined with broken yellow teeth.

645204.name: champion lizardfolk warrior scaled
645204.long_desc: A lizardfolk champion in a harness of gilded scales watches the temple with cold eyes.
645204.description:
Taller than any guard, this warrior wears plates of tarnished gold and
carries a heavy serrated blade. Its crest is dyed a bloody red. The
scars on its snout tell of many duels.

645205.name: basilisk lizard monster
645205.long_desc: A temple basilisk crouches in the shadows, its eight legs scraping on the stone.
645205.description:
This squat, heavy lizard is covered in pitted grey scales, and a crest
of horn runs the length of its back. Its eyes shine a baleful yellow in
the dark. Dribbles of venom hang from its jaws.

645206.name: khessa vraal mother priestess lizardfolk
645206.long_desc: Khessa, the Vraal Mother, tends her clutch of eggs, her crested head swaying.
645206.description:
Khessa is an ancient lizardfolk priestess, her scales faded to grey and
her crest feathered with white. She wears a collar of green stone and
bone fetishes. Her voice is a rasp of old reeds as she calls the God
King's blessing upon you.

645207.name: scaled beast zaebos crocodile monster horror
645207.long_desc: The Scaled Beast of Zaebos, a monstrous crocodilian horror, coils across the floor of its lair.
645207.description:
This is a creature of nightmare, long as a longship and armoured in
plates the colour of wet slate. Its jaws could take a horse. The
lizardfolk feed it and call it the god's own voice.

745200.name: fang blade beast serrated
745200.room_desc: A long serrated blade, hewn from an enormous fang, lies here.
745200.description: A tooth of the Scaled Beast, ground to a sawing edge and bound at the base with wet leather. It is heavier than it looks and cold to the hand.

745201.name: hide armor beast scaled breastplate
745201.room_desc: A breastplate of thick scaled hide lies here.
745201.description: Plates of pitted slate-coloured hide are laced onto a leather harness. It smells faintly of the marsh and turns a blade like a shield.

745202.name: torque vraal bone green stone
745202.short_desc: a torque of green stone and bone
745202.room_desc: A torque of green stone and bone fetishes lies here.
745202.description: Chips of green stone and small yellowed bone charms are strung on a bronze wire. It hums faintly when held.

745203.name: spear barbed lizardman
745203.room_desc: A barbed spear lies here, its shaft stained green.
745203.description: A spear with a wide, barbed head, its shaft wrapped in snakeskin for grip. The balance is odd for human hands but sound.

745204.name: idol zaebos gilded lizard
745204.room_desc: A small gilded idol of a coiled lizard lies here.
745204.description: A palm-sized idol of the God King, cast in gilt bronze, with garnet chips for eyes. A collector would pay well for it.
